claims: Titrate insulin infusion to maintain glucose within target range (e.g., 140-180 mg/dL), given fingerstick glucose 434 mg/dL and 275 mg/dL on insulin drip.
Transfuse packed red blood cells for hemoglobin 7.5 g/dL and hematocrit 23.1% in a critically ill patient.
Continue lung-protective mechanical ventilation with low tidal volume and PEEP, weaning PSV as tolerated.
Continue analgesia/sedation with fentanyl and dexmedetomidine, targeting RASS -1 to -2 and reassessing delirium with CAM-ICU.
Monitor arterial blood gases and lactate; repeat ABG to assess hyperoxia (pO2 168 mmHg) and acid-base status (pH 7.53).
Monitor blood pressure closely given hypotension (MAP 54-59 mmHg) and titrate vasoactive support as needed.
Continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (vancomycin, meropenem) for suspected infection and monitor cultures and urinalysis findings.
Replete electrolytes as needed (magnesium 1.9 mg/dL, calcium 7 mg/dL) and monitor levels.
Perform chest imaging to evaluate pulmonary status and ventilator settings.
Implement VTE prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin and continue stress ulcer prophylaxis with pantoprazole.
